import re

thread=apis.gmail.show_thread(access_token=token, email_thread_id=47820)
emails=thread['emails']
print('emails',[(e['sender']['name'],e['sender']['email']) for e in emails])

# find checklist email from Chris (first one)
checklist_body=None
for e in emails:
    if e['sender']['email']=='chris.mcco@gmail.com':
        # choose the one with bullet list
        if '-' in e['body'] and 'quantity of' in e['body']:
            checklist_body=e['body']
            break
print('checklist_body found', checklist_body is not None)
print(checklist_body)

# parse checklist lines like "- 2 quantity of kite"
pattern=r"-\s*(\d+)\s+quantity of\s+([a-zA-Z\s]+)\s*$"
items=[]
for line in checklist_body.splitlines():
    m=re.search(pattern,line.strip())
    if m:
        qty=int(m.group(1)); name=m.group(2).strip().lower()
        # normalize spaces
        name=re.sub(r"\s+"," ",name)
        items.append((name,qty))
print('parsed checklist items',items)

# parse commitments from other emails
committed=set()
commit_details=[]
for e in emails:
    if e['sender']['email']=='chris.mcco@gmail.com':
        continue
    body=e['body'].lower()
    # find "i will bring ..." portion
    # capture between 'bring' and '.'
    m=re.search(r"i will bring\s+(.+?)[\.!\n]", body, flags=re.IGNORECASE|re.MULTILINE)
    if m:
        bring_part=m.group(1)
        # split by commas
        parts=[p.strip() for p in bring_part.split(',')]
        for p in parts:
            # remove extra words
            # allow "kite" or "board game"
            # if p starts with 'a' or 'an'
            p=re.sub(r"^(a|an)\s+","",p).strip()
            if p:
                committed.add(p)
                commit_details.append((e['sender']['name'],p))
    else:
        # fallback: split all after 'bring'
        m=re.search(r"bring\s+(.+)", body)
        if m:
            bring_part=m.group(1)

print('committed raw',committed)
print('commit_details',commit_details)

# Normalize checklist item names to match committed phrases
# We'll map committed phrases to normalized names by simple lemmatization-ish: remove plural s

def norm(s):
    s=s.strip().lower()
    s=re.sub(r"\s+"," ",s)
    # remove trailing plural 's' for simple cases
    if s.endswith('s'):
        s=s[:-1]
    return s

checklist_map=[(norm(name),qty) for name,qty in items]
committed_norm=set(norm(x) for x in committed)
print('committed_norm',committed_norm)

remaining=[(name,qty) for name,qty in checklist_map if name not in committed_norm]
print('remaining',remaining)

# Build verification table for all items
all_rows=[]
for name,qty in checklist_map:
    committed_by=[cd[0] for cd in commit_details if norm(cd[1])==name]
    all_rows.append((name,qty,', '.join(sorted(set(committed_by))) if committed_by else '—'))
print('VERIFICATION')
for r in all_rows:
    print(r)

def norm(s):
    s=s.strip().lower()
    s=re.sub(r"\s+"," ",s)
    if s.endswith('s') and not s.endswith('ss'):
        s=s[:-1]
    # small normalize
    s=s.replace('disinfecting ','')
    return s

for e in emails:

    body=e['body'].lower()

    if not m:

    bring_part=m.group(2).strip()
    parts=[p.strip() for p in bring_part.split(',')]
    for p in parts:
